scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/tui.tsx src/rpc.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external '@opencode/*' --external '@opentui/*' --external solid-js && bun run check:build
scripts.check:build: bun -e 'import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync("package.json", "utf8")); for (const [name, target] of Object.entries(pkg.exports)) { if (typeof target !== "string" || !existsSync(target)) throw new Error(`missing export ${name}: ${String(target)}`); } for (const file of ["dist/index.js", "dist/tui.js", "dist/rpc.js"]) { if (!existsSync(file)) throw new Error(`missing build output ${file}`); } const tui = readFileSync("dist/tui.js", "utf8"); if (!tui.includes("solid-js")) throw new Error("solid-js is not external in dist/tui.js"); if (tui.includes("function createSignal")) throw new Error("a second Solid runtime is bundled"); console.log(`build exports ok: ${Object.keys(pkg.exports).join(", ")}`);'
